name: Custom Keybinds
description: Custom vanilla keybind support for Geode. updated by coniac

place-checkpoint.name: Place Checkpoint
place-checkpoint.description: Place a Checkpoint in Practice Mode

delete-checkpoint.name: Delete Checkpoint
delete-checkpoint.description: Delete a Checkpoint in Practice Mode

toggle-hitboxes.name: Toggle hitboxes
toggle-hitboxes.description: Toggles hitboxes while in practice mode

restart-level.name: Restart level
restart-level.description: Restarts the Level (needs Quick Keys enabled)

full-restart-level.name: Full restart level
full-restart-level.description: Restarts the level from the beginning (needs Quick Keys enabled)

playback-music.name: Playback Music
playback-music.description: Start / Stop Playing the Level's Music

lock-preview.name: Lock Preview
lock-preview.description: Locks the editor preview line at the center of the camera

toggle-particle-icons.name: Toggle Particle Icons
toggle-particle-icons.description: Toggles between showing particles or showing their icons

toggle-link-controls.name: Toggle Link Controls
toggle-link-controls.description: Soft toggles editor link controls. (Requires "Enable Link Controls" enabled)

toggle-trace-in.name: Toggle Trace In
toggle-trace-in.description: Toggles "Trace In" on the selected object.

toggle-trace-out.name: Toggle Trace Out
toggle-trace-out.description: Toggles "Trace Out" on the selected object.

move-obj-left.name: Move Object Left
move-obj-left.description: Move Selected Object(s) Left 1 Block (30 Units)
